rules: Only settled (won or lost) picks at odds of 1.50 or more count towards the weekly ranking. Void picks add nothing.

tipSupport.title: Recognising consistent Tipsters
tipSupport.body: Puntr Pro will introduce Tipster Support: Punters will be able to recognise verified Tipsters who show a consistent track record on selected leaderboards by sending them PuntPoints. Points have no cash value and can't be withdrawn, and support never influences rankings or pick grading. It opens only once its rules are published. Not available yet.

rules.title: How points work
rules.note: A wrong pick scores nothing. A void pick is not counted. Ties are split by correct picks, then accuracy, then settled picks. If an official result is corrected, the pick is re-scored and the change is recorded. Points rank members only: they are not PuntPoints and have no cash value.
